title: SoundGeneration
description: How the local sound model makes sounds in the computing night (B2530, measurement report D440): steps, lengths per kind, the automatic check of a result (level, silence) and how often it tries again with the next seed. Values are placeholders until Marcel decides.

min_steps.description: Below this the model gives silence (D440: 10 steps silent). The handler raises a smaller requested step count to this.

audible_peak_min.description: A result is silent below this peak (0..1).

seed_retries.description: Tries with seed + 1, + 2 ... after a silent or unusable result, then the base library.

priority.description: Job priority of sound jobs among other jobs (B7 O2). When sound jobs run at all (the computing night) is set in content/hardware/night.json.
